scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Record Series 333 contains moving image and audio recordings from the UCLA Public Information Office. Files include recordings of UCLA on the Air, news coverage, newscasts, public service announcements, public communications, interviews, promotional films, radio shows, inaugurations, commencement, anniversaries, and other UCLA events and happenings. Materials include tapes, reels, audio cassettes, digital audio tapes, Beta SP, VHS, 1/4" audio tapes, 16mm films, slides, 3/4" tapes, 1" reel to reel films, documents, and interview transcripts.
This is an inactive record series; no additional University records are expected to be added.
